readiness.reason: Cell 266-E four-row Thinking decode-cost smoke registered before contact on 2026-10-11 by script (decision 58) from the sealed Fold A direct baseline and the committed Fold B experiment skeleton (owner decision 266-E). HELD: root countersigns the DRAFT rows, mints the admission receipt (scripts/flights/direct/direct_fb_mint_receipt.py), swaps the serving geometry (scripts/flights/batch/serving_swap.sh think-np4, checklist in the package README) and re-pins with scripts/flights/repin_cell.py --set-ready (through scripts/flights/direct/direct_fb_flip.sh). The program declares no supplied first phase (item E38), so the re-pin creates no prepared artifact; --allow-output-change must never be passed. The Thinking cells additionally need the Thinking speech-packet root prepared and its promotion receipt pinned (the baseline carries a zero sentinel the flip refuses). Nothing here authorises a flight, a readiness flip or an admission entry.

core_read_design.chain: smoke -> coordinator decode-cost sign-off -> Thinking arm (Thinking session) -> serving restore -> Instruct arm -> Instruct replicate (Instruct session)
core_read_design.reading: paired per row on the official SLU-F1; the Thinking delta is read against the mean of the two Instruct passes at the cross-flight bar

failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact. No retry, no scoring, no partial quality read. A failed smoke stops the cell and the Thinking arm does not open. A smoke is re-flown whole at most once under one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program (configs/policy/phase-direct-only-v1.json: one phase, max_contacts 1, always-run-full-program) makes exactly ONE contact per row, so 4 x 1 = 4 is the program's exact maximum and its expectation at once. The live phase fit makes 1 + (2 + 1) x 4 = 13 tokenizer endpoint calls under its own run id SAEA-SLURP-DIRECT-ONLY-FOLD-B-THINKING-SMOKE-4-FIT-REC1-V1. The GPU-hour ceiling is a BOUND, never a target. Budgets are run-cumulative across every attempt of a run id. Recovery rec1 (the cell's single one; a second failure closes the cell): the failed predecessor attempt attempt-slurp-direct-only-fold-b-thinking-smoke-4-generation-v1 spent 4 contacts, so the run-cumulative budget is the original plan plus that spend (4 contacts, 9.9395 speech-seconds): 8 calls, 20 speech-seconds.

population.decision_population: TRAIN Fold B (SLURP-DIRECT-FOLD-B-THINKING-SMOKE-4-V1): 4 rows of docs/readiness/2026-10-11-slurp-direct-only-fold-b-thinking-vs-instruct-v1/smoke-roster-receipt-v1.json, the first four rows in roster order; structural decode-cost proof only, no score and no read.

purpose: Four-row decode-cost smoke of the Thinking arm of the 266-E read on the Thinking core (its own session serving-slurp-thinking-direct-fold-b-np4-max8192-v1, completion cap 8192, --reasoning-format deepseek): that the request form, the Thinking packet plane, the reasoning-format option, the live phase fit and the seal work, and what a Thinking answer costs (completion tokens per answer p50/p99, seconds per contact, the GPU-hour projection for 1,080 rows). stage3_algorithm.note: The 266-E read carries NO training-free RL operator and says so explicitly: it is a bare-core capability read -- the sealed direct-only form on two cores -- with no rollout, no per-sample scoring, no credit assignment, no update operator, no evolving store and no mechanism.
